sentences.text: Alice and Bob are visiting a magical park.
You are given an array of $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$.
Determine whether two distinct elements add up to $T$.
It is guaranteed that $1 <= n <= 200000$ and $1 <= a_i <= 10^9$.
For example, if $a = [2, 7, 11]$ and $T = 9$, the answer is YES.
In the year $2050$, Byteasar bought $3$ magical swords for his kingdom.
The kingdom consists of $n$ cities connected by $m$ bidirectional roads.
Your goal is to make all cities reachable from city $1$ using the minimum total cost.
Bob always wanted to find the secret treasure hidden in the mountains.
An array $b$ of length $n$ contains the heights of the mountains.
Return the length of the longest contiguous subarray with sum equal to $k$.
The sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $200000$.
In the first test case, the subarray $[1, 3]$ has sum $5$.
Captain Zara piloted her starship across $7$ distant galaxies.
She hoped to find a new home planet for her crew.
A sequence $d_1, d_2, \dots, d_n$ represents the fuel required for each jump.
Compute the minimum initial fuel needed to complete the journey.
